ex.en: Sami has many followers on Twitter.
ex.zh: 薩米在推特上有很多追蹤者。

ex.en: The singer has over a million followers on Instagram.
ex.zh: 那位歌手在 IG 上有超過一百萬名追蹤者。

follower.en: a person who subscribes to see what someone posts online

ex.en: Rousseau was mad but influential; Hume was sane but had no followers.
ex.zh: 盧梭很瘋狂，卻有影響力；休謨很理智，卻沒有追隨者。

ex.en: The religion has millions of followers.
ex.zh: 這個宗教有數百萬名信徒。

follower.en: a person who supports and believes in someone or an idea

ex.en: Lignite is a fossil fuel.
ex.zh: 褐煤是一種化石燃料。

ex.en: As a result of some factories using fossil fuels, chemical emissions have already caused serious environmental problems.
ex.zh: 由於一些工廠使用化石燃料，化學物質的排放已經造成嚴重的環境問題。

fossil fuel.en: a fuel such as coal, oil or gas made from ancient plants and animals

ex.en: In which folder did you save the file?
ex.zh: 你把檔案存在哪個資料夾裡？

ex.en: I've got hundreds of music folders on my PC.
ex.zh: 我的電腦裡有好幾百個音樂資料夾。

ex.en: Please save the report in the shared folder.
ex.zh: 請把報告存在共用資料夾裡。

folder.en: a place on a computer where you keep files together

ex.en: I have lost one of my folders.
ex.zh: 我弄丟了一個文件夾。

ex.en: Where is my folder?
ex.zh: 我的文件夾去哪了？

folder.en: a folded piece of card for keeping loose papers

ex.en: Let's meet by the fountain in the park.
ex.zh: 我們在公園的噴泉旁碰面吧。

ex.en: Children were playing in the fountain.
ex.zh: 小孩在噴泉裡玩水。

fountain.en: a structure that sends water up into the air

ex.en: He wrote the letter with a fountain pen.
ex.zh: 他是用鋼筆寫這封信的。

ex.en: How much does this fountain pen cost?
ex.zh: 這支鋼筆多少錢？

ex.en: I have lost my new fountain pen.
ex.zh: 我把新鋼筆弄丟了。

fountain.en: a pen that you fill with liquid ink

ex.en: The foreman checked the work on the construction site.
ex.zh: 工頭在工地檢查施工情形。

ex.en: Ask the foreman if you have any questions.
ex.zh: 有任何問題就問領班。

foreman.en: a person who is in charge of a group of workers

ex.en: I do not have an account in these forums.
ex.zh: 我在這些論壇上沒有帳號。

ex.en: I posted my question on an online forum.
ex.zh: 我把問題貼在網路論壇上。

forum.en: a website where people write messages and discuss topics

ex.en: The economic forum will be held in Taipei next month.
ex.zh: 經濟論壇下個月將在台北舉行。

ex.en: The city held a public forum on the new park.
ex.zh: 市政府針對新公園舉辦了公聽會。

forum.en: a public meeting where people discuss important subjects

ex.en: She is not the founder, she's the investor.
ex.zh: 她不是創辦人，她是投資人。

ex.en: In the center of the university campus stands the statue of the founder.
ex.zh: 大學校園中央立著創校者的雕像。

ex.en: The company's founder still works there every day.
ex.zh: 公司創辦人至今仍每天到公司上班。

founder.en: a person who starts an organization or company

ex.en: Fortunately, no passengers were injured.
ex.zh: 幸好沒有乘客受傷。

ex.en: Fortunately, Dan was on the way.
ex.zh: 幸好丹已經在路上了。

ex.en: Fortunately, the meeting was postponed.
ex.zh: 幸好會議延期了。

fortunately.en: in a way that shows something good happened by chance

ex.en: The thick fog made it hard to see the road.
ex.zh: 濃霧讓人很難看清路面。

ex.en: The fog began to disappear around ten o'clock.
ex.zh: 霧在十點左右開始散去。

ex.en: As the sun rose, the fog disappeared.
ex.zh: 太陽升起後，霧就散了。

fog.en: thick cloud near the ground that makes it hard to see

fog.zh: （使）起霧、蒙上霧氣（常用 fog up）

ex.en: My glasses fogged up when I walked inside.
ex.zh: 我一走進室內，眼鏡就起霧了。

ex.en: The bathroom mirror fogs up after a hot shower.
ex.zh: 洗完熱水澡後，浴室的鏡子會起霧。

fog.en: to become covered with tiny drops of water so you cannot see through

ex.en: French is the only foreign language I've ever formally studied.
ex.zh: 法語是我唯一正式學過的外語。

ex.en: The new CEO will be formally introduced on Monday.
ex.zh: 新任執行長將在週一正式與大家見面。

ex.en: Please dress formally for the dinner.
ex.zh: 晚宴請穿著正式服裝。

formally.en: in an official or serious way

ex.en: Students are forbidden to smoke on the school grounds.
ex.zh: 學生不准在校園內抽菸。

ex.en: It is forbidden to cross the white line.
ex.zh: 禁止越過白線。

ex.en: The company forbids employees from sharing passwords.
ex.zh: 公司禁止員工分享密碼。

forbid.en: to say that someone must not do something

ex.en: We use chopsticks in place of knives and forks.
ex.zh: 我們用筷子，不用刀叉。

ex.en: Give us two knives and four forks, please.
ex.zh: 請給我們兩把刀和四支叉子。

fork.en: a tool with points that you use to pick up food

ex.en: We've come to a fork in the road.
ex.zh: 我們來到了岔路口。

ex.en: Turn left at the fork in the road.
ex.zh: 在岔路口左轉。

fork.en: a place where a road or river divides into two parts

fork.zh: fork out：（不情願地）掏錢、花大錢

ex.en: We had to fork out 500 dollars for repairs.
ex.zh: 我們不得不掏出 500 元修理費。

ex.en: I don't want to fork out that much for a phone.
ex.zh: 我不想花那麼多錢買手機。

fork.en: to pay a lot of money for something, without wanting to

ex.en: The program aims to foster creativity in children.
ex.zh: 這個計畫旨在培養孩子的創造力。

ex.en: We want to foster a culture of teamwork.
ex.zh: 我們希望培養團隊合作的文化。

foster.en: to help something grow or develop

ex.en: They have been foster parents for ten years.
ex.zh: 他們當寄養父母已經十年了。

ex.en: The child was placed in a foster home.
ex.zh: 那個孩子被安置在寄養家庭。

foster.en: looking after a child who is not your own for a time

ex.en: The store sells clothing and footwear.
ex.zh: 這家店賣服飾和鞋類。

ex.en: Wear comfortable footwear for the hike.
ex.zh: 健行要穿舒適的鞋子。

footwear.en: things you wear on your feet, such as shoes and boots

ex.en: The greater part of the guests were foreigners.
ex.zh: 大部分的客人都是外國人。

ex.en: His accent suggests he is a foreigner.
ex.zh: 從他的口音聽得出他是外國人。

ex.en: This rule is applied to foreigners only.
ex.zh: 這條規定只適用於外國人。

ex.en: Formerly this building was a hospital.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓以前是醫院。

ex.en: The café was formerly a bookstore.
ex.zh: 這間咖啡廳以前是書店。

ex.en: Amy formerly worked for a bank in Taipei.
ex.zh: Amy 以前在台北的一家銀行上班。

formerly.en: at an earlier time in the past

ex.en: This is a forged banknote.
ex.zh: 這是一張偽鈔。

ex.en: He was caught forging his boss's signature.
ex.zh: 他被抓到偽造老闆的簽名。

forge.en: to make a false copy of something to trick people

ex.en: We hope to forge a strong partnership with them.
ex.zh: 我們希望和他們建立穩固的合作關係。

ex.en: The two companies forged a new alliance.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司結成了新的聯盟。

forge.en: to work hard to build a strong relationship

ex.en: We need to formulate a new marketing strategy.
ex.zh: 我們需要制訂新的行銷策略。

ex.en: The city formulated a plan to reduce traffic.
ex.zh: 市政府擬定了一項減少車流的計畫。

formulate.en: to carefully prepare a plan or idea

ex.en: He took a moment to formulate his answer.
ex.zh: 他花了一點時間組織他的回答。

ex.en: She found it hard to formulate her thoughts in English.
ex.zh: 她覺得很難用英文清楚表達自己的想法。

formulate.en: to put thoughts into clear words

ex.en: Details will be announced at the forthcoming meeting.
ex.zh: 細節將在即將召開的會議上公布。

ex.en: We look forward to your forthcoming book.
ex.zh: 我們很期待您即將出版的新書。

forthcoming.en: going to happen or appear soon

forthcoming.zh: （資訊、協助）主動提供的；坦白的

ex.en: He wasn't very forthcoming about his plans.
ex.zh: 他對自己的計畫不太願意多說。

ex.en: No explanation was forthcoming from the company.
ex.zh: 公司一直沒有給出任何解釋。

ex.en: I'm afraid this is an incorrect formulation of the question.
ex.zh: 恐怕這個問題的提法不正確。

ex.en: The formulation of the new policy took months.
ex.zh: 新政策的制定花了好幾個月。

formulation.en: the way something is carefully planned or put into words

ex.en: The company changed the formulation of its shampoo.
ex.zh: 這家公司改變了洗髮精的配方。

ex.en: This new formulation is gentler on the skin.
ex.zh: 這個新配方對皮膚更溫和。

formulation.en: the mixture of materials used to make a product

ex.en: The weather forecaster predicted heavy rain tomorrow.
ex.zh: 氣象預報員預測明天會下大雨。

ex.en: Economic forecasters expect growth to slow next year.
ex.zh: 經濟預測專家預期明年成長會趨緩。

forecaster.en: a person whose job is to say what will happen in the future

ex.en: The dog followed its master, wagging its tail.
ex.zh: 狗搖著尾巴跟著主人。

ex.en: Please follow me.
ex.zh: 請跟我來。

follow.en: to go or come after someone or something

ex.en: All you have to do is follow his advice.
ex.zh: 你只要照他的建議做就好。

ex.en: It was sensible of you to follow her advice.
ex.zh: 你聽她的建議是明智的。

follow.en: to do what someone says or what a rule tells you

ex.en: The following is a summary of the President's speech.
ex.zh: 以下是總統演講的摘要。

ex.en: Not until the following morning did we see land.
ex.zh: 直到第二天早上，我們才看到陸地。

follow.en: used to introduce the things that come next

ex.en: Round-trip fares to each destination are as follows.
ex.zh: 前往各目的地的來回票價如下。

ex.en: The schedule is as follows.
ex.zh: 行程如下。

follow.en: used to introduce a list or explanation that comes next

ex.en: Sorry, I don't follow you.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我聽不懂你的意思。

ex.en: Did you follow the explanation?
ex.zh: 你聽懂剛才的說明了嗎？

follow.en: to understand what someone is saying

ex.en: I was forced to go to work on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我被迫星期天去上班。

ex.en: No one is forcing you to do this.
ex.zh: 沒有人逼你做這件事。

ex.en: I will never force you to marry him.
ex.zh: 我絕不會逼你嫁給他。

force.en: to make someone do something they do not want to do

ex.en: What can be done? These are market forces.
ex.zh: 能怎麼辦？這些都是市場力量。

ex.en: The wind blew with great force.
ex.zh: 風颳得非常猛烈。

force.en: power or strength that makes things happen or move

ex.en: The new law is now in force.
ex.zh: 新法現在已經生效。

ex.en: These rules remain in force.
ex.zh: 這些規定仍然有效。

force.en: officially working and having to be obeyed

ex.en: The lions fought with each other to get food.
ex.zh: 獅子為了搶食物互相打鬥。

ex.en: High calorie foods are bad for my health.
ex.zh: 高熱量的食物對我的身體不好。

ex.en: Some foods make you thirsty.
ex.zh: 有些食物會讓你口渴。

food.en: things that people and animals eat

ex.en: Do you like to cook Japanese foods?
ex.zh: 你喜歡煮日本料理嗎？

ex.en: Do you like spicy food?
ex.zh: 你喜歡吃辣嗎？

food.en: a particular type of cooking or dishes

ex.en: He focused on his studies.
ex.zh: 他專心於學業。

ex.en: I can't focus on two things at the same time.
ex.zh: 我沒辦法同時專心做兩件事。

ex.en: The discussion focused on unemployment.
ex.zh: 討論的重點在失業問題。

focus.en: to give all your attention to one thing

ex.en: The main focus of the meeting is the new budget.
ex.zh: 會議的重點是新預算。

ex.en: Customer service is our top focus this year.
ex.zh: 客戶服務是我們今年的首要重點。

focus.en: the main thing that people give attention to

ex.en: He was covered with mud from head to foot.
ex.zh: 他從頭到腳都是泥巴。

ex.en: There's a pencil on the floor near your feet.
ex.zh: 你腳邊的地上有一支鉛筆。

ex.en: Her feet were tired after a long day at work.
ex.zh: 工作了一整天，她的腳很累。

foot.en: the part at the end of the leg that you stand on

ex.en: Do you go to school on foot every day?
ex.zh: 你每天走路上學嗎？

ex.en: The hotel is five minutes from here on foot.
ex.zh: 飯店從這裡走路五分鐘。

ex.en: The room is about 12 feet wide.
ex.zh: 這個房間大約十二英尺寬。

ex.en: He is six feet tall.
ex.zh: 他身高六英尺。

foot.en: a unit of length equal to about thirty centimeters

ex.en: Her house is at the foot of a mountain.
ex.zh: 她家在山腳下。

ex.en: Please sign at the foot of the page.
ex.zh: 請在頁面底部簽名。

foot.en: the lowest part of something such as a hill

ex.en: When I met my former teacher, he inquired after my parents.
ex.zh: 我遇到以前的老師時，他問候了我的父母。

ex.en: Kyoto is the former capital of Japan.
ex.zh: 京都是日本的舊都。

ex.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
ex.zh: 大家都很想知道前冠軍後來怎麼樣了。

former.en: having been something in the past but not now

ex.en: Either one is fine, but the former is more concise.
ex.zh: 兩個都可以，但前者比較簡潔。

ex.en: Of the two options, I prefer the former.
ex.zh: 兩個選項中，我比較喜歡前者。

former.en: the first of two things that were just mentioned

ex.en: Don't forget to take your umbrella when you leave.
ex.zh: 你出門時別忘了帶傘。

ex.en: I meant to call her, but I forgot to.
ex.zh: 我本來要打電話給她，結果忘了。

ex.en: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.
ex.zh: 湯姆從沒忘記在結婚紀念日送花給太太。

forget.en: to be unable to remember something

ex.en: He hurt his foot, he can't play football anymore.
ex.zh: 他腳受傷了，不能再踢足球。

ex.en: A football team consists of eleven players.
ex.zh: 一支足球隊有十一名球員。

ex.en: The football game is now on the air.
ex.zh: 足球賽正在播出。

football.en: a team sport with a ball: kicked in Britain, but carried and thrown in America

ex.en: The forests in Taiwan stay green all year round.
ex.zh: 台灣的森林終年常綠。

ex.en: The boy lost his way in the forest.
ex.zh: 小男孩在森林裡迷路了。

ex.en: Water, forests, and minerals are important natural resources.
ex.zh: 水、森林和礦物都是重要的天然資源。

forest.en: a large area covered with trees

ex.en: We have to sing at an old folks home today.
ex.zh: 我們今天得去養老院唱歌。

ex.en: Some folks prefer to work from home.
ex.zh: 有些人比較喜歡在家工作。

ex.en: I'm going to visit my folks this weekend.
ex.zh: 我這個週末要回去看爸媽。

ex.en: How are your folks doing?
ex.zh: 你爸媽最近好嗎？

ex.en: We listened to traditional folk music.
ex.zh: 我們聽了傳統民謠。

ex.en: The story is based on an old folk tale.
ex.zh: 這個故事改編自一則古老的民間故事。

folk.en: relating to the traditional culture of ordinary people

ex.en: You don't need to prepare a formal speech.
ex.zh: 你不需要準備正式的演講。

ex.en: How formal is this ceremony?
ex.zh: 這個典禮有多正式？

ex.en: You don't have to be so formal.
ex.zh: 你不必那麼拘謹。

formal.en: serious and correct, not relaxed or casual

ex.en: He had little formal education.
ex.zh: 他沒受過什麼正規教育。

ex.en: You don't need formal training for this job.
ex.zh: 這份工作不需要受過正規訓練。

formal.en: officially taught and recognized, such as in a school

ex.en: He walked back and forth in front of the door, hesitating to enter.
ex.zh: 他在門口走來走去，猶豫要不要進去。

ex.en: He walked back and forth on the platform while waiting for the train.
ex.zh: 他一邊等火車，一邊在月台上走來走去。

ex.en: Sami and Layla kept texting back and forth.
ex.zh: 薩米和萊拉不停地互傳簡訊。

forth.en: moving in one direction and then the other again and again

ex.en: He asked me my age, my name, my address, and so forth.
ex.zh: 他問了我的年齡、名字、地址等等。

ex.en: We need pens, paper, folders, and so forth.
ex.zh: 我們需要筆、紙、資料夾等等。

forth.en: used at the end of a list to mean more things like these

forth.zh: 向前、向外（如 put forth、set forth 提出）

ex.en: The report sets forth several new ideas.
ex.zh: 這份報告提出了幾個新想法。

ex.en: She put forth a proposal at the meeting.
ex.zh: 她在會議上提出了一項提案。

forth.en: out or forward, as when presenting an idea

ex.en: The chemical formula for water is H-O-H.
ex.zh: 水的化學式是 H-O-H。

ex.en: Use this formula to calculate the total cost.
ex.zh: 用這個公式計算總成本。

formula.en: a set of letters or numbers showing a rule or the parts of a substance

ex.en: There is no magic formula for success.
ex.zh: 成功沒有神奇的祕訣。

ex.en: The company found a winning formula.
ex.zh: 這家公司找到了成功的模式。

formula.en: a fixed plan or method for getting a result

ex.en: Mathematics are the foundation of all sciences.
ex.zh: 數學是所有科學的基礎。

ex.en: Food, clothing and shelter are the foundations of survival.
ex.zh: 衣食住是生存的基礎。

foundation.en: the base that something is built on

ex.en: The rumor was without foundation.
ex.zh: 這個謠言毫無根據。

ex.en: The claims in the report have no foundation.
ex.zh: 報告中的說法沒有根據。

foundation.en: the facts or reason that make an idea believable

ex.en: The foundation provides scholarships for poor students.
ex.zh: 這個基金會為清寒學生提供獎學金。

ex.en: She works for a charitable foundation.
ex.zh: 她在一個慈善基金會工作。

foundation.en: an organization that gives money for a good purpose

ex.en: Fundamentally, the formation of the twelve zodiac signs is related to animal worship.
ex.zh: 從根本上說，十二生肖的形成與動物崇拜有關。

ex.en: The formation of the new team took several months.
ex.zh: 新團隊的組成花了好幾個月。

formation.en: the process of making or developing something

ex.en: There are several kinds of cloud formations.
ex.zh: 雲的形態有好幾種。

ex.en: The planes flew in formation over the city.
ex.zh: 飛機以編隊飛越城市上空。

formation.en: the way something is arranged or shaped

ex.en: Please send the file in PDF format.
ex.zh: 請用 PDF 格式傳送檔案。

ex.en: The meeting will follow a new format.
ex.zh: 會議將採用新的形式進行。

format.en: the way something is arranged or the type of file it is

ex.en: I've formatted your hard disk by mistake.
ex.zh: 我不小心格式化了你的硬碟。

ex.en: Please format the report before you send it.
ex.zh: 寄出報告前請先排好版。

format.en: to prepare a disk for use, or to arrange text on a page

ex.en: He will forever live on in our memories.
ex.zh: 他將永遠活在我們的記憶中。

ex.en: It's not possible for humans to live forever.
ex.zh: 人類不可能長生不老。

ex.en: I'll remember this day forever.
ex.zh: 我會永遠記得這一天。

forever.en: for all time, without ever ending

ex.en: It would take forever for me to explain everything.
ex.zh: 要我把一切都解釋清楚，得花上好久好久。

ex.en: It took forever to get through security.
ex.zh: 通過安檢花了超久的時間。

forever.en: for a very long time, or all the time

ex.en: He lost a fortune in the stock market.
ex.zh: 他在股市賠了一大筆錢。

ex.en: He amassed a large fortune before he died.
ex.zh: 他過世前累積了龐大的財富。

ex.en: He has made a fortune through hard work.
ex.zh: 他靠努力工作賺了大錢。

fortune.en: a very large amount of money

ex.en: I had the good fortune to be chosen.
ex.zh: 我很幸運能被選上。

ex.en: We had the good fortune to meet a helpful local guide.
ex.zh: 我們很幸運遇到一位熱心的當地導遊。

fortune.en: good or bad things that happen to you by chance

ex.en: Tom folded the paper before handing it to Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆先把紙摺起來才交給瑪麗。

ex.en: If you don't fold your clothes or hang them, they will be wrinkled.
ex.zh: 衣服如果不摺好或掛起來，就會皺掉。

ex.en: Please fold the towels and put them away.
ex.zh: 請把毛巾摺好收起來。

fold.en: to bend something so that one part lies on another

ex.en: He folded his arms and waited.
ex.zh: 他雙臂交叉等著。

ex.en: She stood with her arms folded.
ex.zh: 她雙臂交叉站著。

fold.en: to cross your arms over your chest

ex.en: The restaurant folded after only six months.
ex.zh: 那家餐廳開了半年就倒了。

ex.en: Many small businesses folded during the recession.
ex.zh: 很多小企業在不景氣時倒閉了。

fold.en: to close because of money problems

ex.en: That's nonsense. Nobody but a fool would believe it.
ex.zh: 那是胡說八道，只有傻瓜才會相信。

ex.en: I felt like a fool for believing him.
ex.zh: 我竟然相信他，覺得自己像個傻瓜。

fool.en: a person who does silly things

ex.en: I was angry that I had been fooled.
ex.zh: 我很氣自己被騙了。

ex.en: Don't let his smile fool you.
ex.zh: 別被他的笑容騙了。

fool.en: to trick someone into believing something false

ex.en: Stop fooling around.
ex.zh: 別再胡鬧了。

ex.en: The kids were fooling around in the classroom.
ex.zh: 孩子們在教室裡胡鬧。

fool.en: to behave in a silly way and waste time

fool.zh: make a fool of：讓…出醜、耍弄

ex.en: Are you trying to make a fool of me?
ex.zh: 你是想耍我嗎？

ex.en: I made a fool of myself at the party.
ex.zh: 我在派對上出糗了。

ex.en: You are very fortunate that you have such friends.
ex.zh: 你們很幸運有這樣的朋友。

ex.en: They consider themselves fortunate.
ex.zh: 他們覺得自己很幸運。

ex.en: I am fortunate compared with him.
ex.zh: 跟他比起來，我算是很幸運的。

ex.en: The university was founded by his father twenty years ago.
ex.zh: 這所大學是他父親二十年前創辦的。

ex.en: He founded the school five years ago.
ex.zh: 他五年前創辦了這所學校。

ex.en: He was still in his teens when he founded a company.
ex.zh: 他十幾歲就創立了一家公司。

found.en: to start an organization or company

found.zh: find 的過去式／過去分詞：找到、發現

ex.en: I found a bird whose wing was severely damaged.
ex.zh: 我發現了一隻翅膀嚴重受傷的鳥。

ex.en: When I opened the door, I found him asleep.
ex.zh: 我開門時，發現他睡著了。

ex.en: It was lucky for you that you found it.
ex.zh: 你能找到它真是幸運。

found.en: to have discovered or got something you were looking for

ex.en: See the footnote at the bottom of the page.
ex.zh: 請看頁面下方的註腳。

ex.en: Add a footnote to explain the source of the data.
ex.zh: 加一個註腳說明資料來源。

footnote.en: a note at the bottom of a page that gives extra information

ex.en: The incident became a mere footnote in history.
ex.zh: 這起事件在歷史上只是個小插曲。

ex.en: His comment was only a footnote to the main discussion.
ex.zh: 他的意見只是主要討論的附帶一提。

footnote.en: a minor thing that is not very important

ex.en: What I have in my hand is a fossil seashell.
ex.zh: 我手上拿的是一個貝殼化石。

ex.en: They found dinosaur fossils in the desert.
ex.zh: 他們在沙漠中發現了恐龍化石。

fossil.en: the remains of an ancient animal or plant preserved in rock

ex.en: Lignite is a fossil fuel.
ex.zh: 褐煤是一種化石燃料。

ex.en: We need to reduce our use of fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 我們需要減少使用化石燃料。

fossil.en: a fuel such as coal, oil or gas made from ancient plants and animals

ex.en: The workflow is illustrated in the following chart.
ex.zh: 工作流程如下圖所示。

ex.en: The following is the project's progress.
ex.zh: 以下是專案的進度。

ex.en: Answer the following questions in English.
ex.zh: 用英文回答下列問題。

following.en: coming next in a text or list

ex.en: Tom came on Monday and went back home the following day.
ex.zh: Tom 星期一來，隔天就回家了。

ex.en: Not until the following morning did we see land.
ex.zh: 直到隔天早上，我們才看到陸地。

ex.en: The singer has a huge following on social media.
ex.zh: 那位歌手在社群媒體上擁有大批粉絲。

ex.en: The small café has built a loyal following.
ex.zh: 這家小咖啡館累積了一群忠實顧客。

following.en: a group of people who support or admire someone

ex.en: Following the meeting, lunch will be served.
ex.zh: 會議結束後將供應午餐。

ex.en: Sales rose sharply following the ad campaign.
ex.zh: 廣告活動之後，銷售量大幅上升。

following.en: after, or as a result of

ex.en: Her smile indicates that she has forgiven me.
ex.zh: 她臉上的笑容，代表她已經原諒我了。

ex.en: She forgave the boy for his rudeness.
ex.zh: 她原諒了男孩的粗魯。

ex.en: If he told me the truth, I would have forgiven him.
ex.zh: 如果他跟我說實話，我早就原諒他了。

forgive.en: to stop being angry with someone for something they did

ex.en: It was so foggy I couldn't tell who it was.
ex.zh: 霧太大了，我看不清楚是誰。

ex.en: It's foggy here in Boston.
ex.zh: 波士頓這裡霧很大。

ex.en: She slowly disappeared into the foggy forest.
ex.zh: 她緩緩消失在霧氣瀰漫的森林中。

foggy.en: covered with thick cloud near the ground

ex.en: My memory of that night is a bit foggy.
ex.zh: 我對那晚的記憶有點模糊。

ex.en: I feel foggy in the morning before coffee.
ex.zh: 早上沒喝咖啡前我腦袋都昏昏沉沉的。

ex.en: The weather forecast says it will be fine tomorrow.
ex.zh: 氣象預報說明天會是好天氣。

ex.en: According to the weather forecast, tomorrow will be snowy.
ex.zh: 天氣預報說明天會下雪。

ex.en: I heard the weather forecast said it'll rain tonight.
ex.zh: 我聽天氣預報說今晚會下雨。

forecast.en: a statement about what the weather will be like

ex.en: The news forecasts fine weather, but it seems like it is going to rain.
ex.zh: 新聞預報是好天氣，但看起來好像要下雨了。

ex.en: Experts forecast slower economic growth next year.
ex.zh: 專家預測明年經濟成長會放緩。

forecast.en: to say what you think will happen in the future

ex.en: He has a great fondness for music.
ex.zh: 他非常喜歡音樂。

ex.en: She has a deep fondness for her grandmother's cooking.
ex.zh: 她特別喜愛外婆做的菜。

fondness.en: a feeling of liking someone or something

fond.zh: 喜愛的、愛好的（常用 fond of）

ex.en: He is fond of watching baseball games on TV.
ex.zh: 他喜歡看電視上的棒球比賽。

ex.en: Generally speaking, Americans are very fond of coffee.
ex.zh: 美國人一般都很喜歡喝咖啡。

ex.en: We have a cat. We are all fond of it.
ex.zh: 我們有一隻貓。我們都喜歡貓。

ex.en: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
ex.zh: 你該結束這種愚蠢的行為了。

ex.en: It was foolish of you to accept his offer.
ex.zh: 你真笨去接受他的提議。

ex.en: How foolish I was not to discover that simple lie!
ex.zh: 我竟然蠢得被這麼簡單的謊話騙倒了！

ex.en: In Taiwanese folklore, the Moon Lady lives on the moon.
ex.zh: 在台灣民間傳說中，嫦娥住在月亮上。

ex.en: She studies the folklore of Indigenous peoples.
ex.zh: 她研究原住民的民間傳說。

folklore.en: the traditional stories and beliefs of a people

ex.en: It is not easy to learn a foreign language.
ex.zh: 學外語不容易。

ex.en: Mastering a foreign language involves a lot of patience.
ex.zh: 要精通一門外語需要很大的耐心。

ex.en: You must go to a foreign country for yourself.
ex.zh: 你一定要親自去國外看看。

foreign.en: from or in a country that is not your own

ex.en: The idea of saving money was foreign to him.
ex.zh: 存錢這個觀念對他來說很陌生。

ex.en: Remove any foreign objects from the wound.
ex.zh: 清除傷口裡的異物。

foreign.en: not known to you or not natural to a place

ex.en: Can you tell me how to fill in this form?
ex.zh: 你能告訴我這份表格怎麼填嗎？

ex.en: Please fill out this form and sign at the bottom.
ex.zh: 請填寫這份表格並在下方簽名。

form.en: a printed paper with spaces for you to write information

ex.en: Water and ice are the same substance in different forms.
ex.zh: 水和冰雖然形態不同，但其實是同一種物質。

ex.en: The grammatical form employed here is the present progressive.
ex.zh: 這裡用的文法形式是現在進行式。

form.en: a particular kind or shape of something

ex.en: A long queue had formed in front of the shop.
ex.zh: 店門前排起了長長的人龍。

ex.en: He formed a habit of staying up late.
ex.zh: 他養成了熬夜的習慣。

form.en: to start to exist or make something exist

ex.en: I sent a follow-up after the client meeting.
ex.zh: 我在客戶會議後寄出了後續郵件。

ex.en: The follow-up confirmed the revised delivery date.
ex.zh: 後續通知確認了修訂後的交貨日期。

follow-up.en: something done later to continue or check earlier work

ex.en: The retailer gained a foothold in the regional market.
ex.zh: 這家零售商在區域市場站穩了腳步。

ex.en: A local partnership gave us a foothold overseas.
ex.zh: 當地合作夥伴讓我們在海外建立了據點。

foothold.en: a small first position from which you can make progress

ex.en: The bank offers foreign exchange services at the airport.
ex.zh: 這家銀行在機場提供外幣兌換服務。

ex.en: Foreign exchange rates changed during the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午外匯匯率出現變動。

foreign exchange.en: the system of changing money from one country into money of another

ex.en: The forklift moved the pallets into the warehouse.
ex.zh: 堆高機將棧板移進倉庫。

ex.en: Only trained staff may operate the forklift.
ex.zh: 只有受過訓練的員工才能操作堆高機。

forklift.en: a small vehicle with two metal arms for lifting heavy goods

ex.en: The homeowners faced foreclosure after missing several payments.
ex.zh: 屋主多次未繳款後，面臨房屋遭法拍。

ex.en: A housing counselor helped the family avoid foreclosure.
ex.zh: 住宅諮詢員協助這個家庭避免房屋遭法拍。

foreclosure.en: the legal act of taking a property because the owner cannot pay the loan

ex.en: I'll follow up with the client next week.
ex.zh: 我下週會再跟客戶聯絡追蹤。

ex.en: Please follow up on the issues we discussed today.
ex.zh: 請針對今天討論的問題後續追蹤。

follow up.en: to contact someone again or take more action about something

ex.en: Could you forward me the email from the client?
ex.zh: 可以把客戶寄來的那封信轉寄給我嗎？

ex.en: I forwarded your message to the sales team.
ex.zh: 我已經把你的訊息轉給業務團隊了。

forward.en: to send a message or letter on to another person

ex.en: They are going forwards and I am always going backwards.
ex.zh: 他們一直往前走，而我總是在往後退。

ex.en: She stepped forward to ask a question.
ex.zh: 她往前走一步提出問題。

forward.en: in the direction that is in front of you

ex.en: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
ex.zh: 我期待很快就能收到你的信。

ex.en: I look forward to seeing you again very soon.
ex.zh: 希望早日再見到你。

ex.en: I am looking forward to seeing you next Sunday.
ex.zh: 我期待下週日能見到你。

forward.en: to feel happy about something that is going to happen

ex.en: The nurse put her hand on my forehead to check my fever.
ex.zh: 護士把手放在我的額頭上量體溫。

ex.en: He wiped the sweat from his forehead.
ex.zh: 他擦掉額頭上的汗。

ex.en: We're going on holiday for a fortnight in August.
ex.zh: 我們八月要去度假兩個星期。

ex.en: The package should arrive within a fortnight.
ex.zh: 包裹應該會在兩週內送到。

ex.en: A red fox ran across the road.
ex.zh: 一隻紅狐狸跑過馬路。

ex.en: Foxes are quiet and clever animals.
ex.zh: 狐狸是安靜又聰明的動物。

ex.en: My grandfather was a sly old fox.
ex.zh: 我祖父是隻狡猾的老狐狸。

ex.en: She is a clever fox in business.
ex.zh: 她在商場上是個精明的狐狸。

ex.en: I made a cup of tea for you.
ex.zh: 我幫你泡了一杯茶。

ex.en: We saved money for a trip to Japan.
ex.zh: 我們為了去日本旅行而存錢。

for.zh: 持續（一段時間，for two years 兩年之久）

ex.en: He has lived in this city for two years.
ex.zh: 他已經在這座城市住了兩年。

ex.en: We waited for an hour before the bus came.
ex.zh: 我們等了一個小時公車才來。

ex.en: She did not go out, for it was raining heavily.
ex.zh: 她沒有出門，因為雨下得很大。

ex.en: He felt tired, for he had worked all night.
ex.zh: 他覺得很累，因為他整晚都在工作。

ex.en: There are four chairs around the table.
ex.zh: 桌子周圍有四張椅子。

ex.en: My sister is four years older than me.
ex.zh: 我姊姊比我大四歲。

ex.en: We waited at the station until four.
ex.zh: 我們在車站一直等到四點。

ex.en: My father is forty years old.
ex.zh: 我的父親四十歲。

ex.en: There are forty seats in this classroom.
ex.zh: 這間教室有四十個座位。

ex.en: The bus ride takes about forty minutes.
ex.zh: 搭公車大約要四十分鐘。

ex.en: She finished fourth in the swimming race.
ex.zh: 她在游泳比賽中得到第四名。

ex.en: Our office is on the fourth floor of the building.
ex.zh: 我們的辦公室在這棟大樓的四樓。

ex.en: A fourth of the students walk to school every day.
ex.zh: 四分之一的學生每天走路上學。

ex.en: My little sister turns fourteen next month.
ex.zh: 我妹妹下個月滿十四歲。

ex.en: There are fourteen students in our English class.
ex.zh: 我們的英文班有十四位學生。

ford.zh: 淺灘（可涉水而過的河段）

ex.en: The hikers crossed the river at a shallow ford.
ex.zh: 登山客在一處淺灘過河。

ex.en: There used to be a ford here before the bridge was built.
ex.zh: 橋建好之前，這裡有一處可涉水而過的淺灘。

ex.en: We had to ford the stream to reach the other side.
ex.zh: 我們得涉水過溪才能到對岸。

ex.en: The cattle forded the river slowly.
ex.zh: 牛群慢慢地涉過了河。

ex.en: The crowd moved slowly forwards toward the stage.
ex.zh: 人群慢慢地向舞台前進。

ex.en: She leaned forwards to hear him better.
ex.zh: 她身體前傾，好聽得更清楚。

ex.en: The team faced a formidable opponent in the final.
ex.zh: 球隊在決賽中遇到了一個難纏的對手。

ex.en: Her formidable reputation made everyone nervous.
ex.zh: 她令人敬畏的名聲讓大家都很緊張。

ex.en: He has a formidable memory and never forgets a name.
ex.zh: 他的記憶力驚人，從不忘記別人的名字。

ex.en: Climbing the steep mountain was a formidable challenge.
ex.zh: 攀登那座陡峭的山是一項艱鉅的挑戰。

ex.en: It would be folly to drive in such a heavy storm.
ex.zh: 在這麼大的暴風雨中開車是很愚蠢的。

ex.en: He later admitted the folly of his decision.
ex.zh: 他後來承認自己的決定很愚蠢。

ex.en: I heard a footstep behind me and turned around.
ex.zh: 我聽到背後有腳步聲，就轉過頭去。

ex.en: Footsteps echoed along the empty hallway.
ex.zh: 腳步聲在空蕩蕩的走廊裡迴響。

ex.en: He studied forestry because he loves working outdoors.
ex.zh: 他念林業，因為他喜歡在戶外工作。

ex.en: Forestry is an important industry in this mountain region.
ex.zh: 林業是這個山區的重要產業。

ex.en: The police checked the security camera footage to find out what happened.
ex.zh: 警方調閱監視器畫面，查明發生了什麼事。

ex.en: The documentary includes rare footage of wild pandas.
ex.zh: 這部紀錄片收錄了野生大貓熊的罕見畫面。

ex.en: The company announced a forced move to a smaller office.
ex.zh: 公司宣布被迫搬到比較小的辦公室。

ex.en: He made a forced landing in a field because of engine trouble.
ex.zh: 因為引擎故障，他被迫降落在一片田野上。

ex.en: The forced closure of the road caused heavy traffic.
ex.zh: 道路被迫封閉造成交通嚴重壅塞。

ex.en: She gave a forced smile and said she was fine.
ex.zh: 她勉強擠出一個笑容，說她沒事。

ex.en: His laugh sounded forced, as if he didn't find the joke funny.
ex.zh: 他的笑聲聽起來很勉強，好像並不覺得那個笑話好笑。

ex.en: The waves left white foam on the sand.
ex.zh: 海浪在沙灘上留下白色的泡沫。

ex.en: I like a lot of foam on my coffee.
ex.zh: 我喜歡咖啡上有很多奶泡。

ex.en: Soap foam covered the surface of the sink.
ex.zh: 肥皂泡沫覆蓋了水槽的表面。

ex.en: The soda began to foam when I opened it.
ex.zh: 我打開汽水時，它開始冒泡。

ex.en: Shampoo will foam more in warm water.
ex.zh: 洗髮精遇到溫水會起更多泡沫。

ex.en: She is one of the foremost scientists in her field.
ex.zh: 她是這個領域最重要的科學家之一。

ex.en: Safety must be our foremost concern.
ex.zh: 安全必須是我們首要考量。

ex.en: No one could have foreseen such a big change.
ex.zh: 沒有人能預料到這麼大的改變。

ex.en: I don't foresee any problems with the plan.
ex.zh: 我不認為這個計畫會有任何問題。

ex.en: Wrap the fish in foil before putting it in the oven.
ex.zh: 把魚用錫箔紙包好再放進烤箱。

ex.en: Aluminum foil is useful in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 鋁箔紙在廚房裡很好用。

ex.en: The guards foiled the thief's attempt to escape.
ex.zh: 警衛挫敗了小偷逃跑的企圖。

ex.en: Bad weather foiled our plans for a picnic.
ex.zh: 壞天氣破壞了我們野餐的計畫。

ex.en: His calm attitude is a perfect foil to her excitement.
ex.zh: 他沉穩的態度正好襯托出她的興奮。

ex.en: In the story, the quiet sister is a foil for the loud one.
ex.zh: 在故事裡，安靜的姊姊襯托出吵鬧的妹妹。

ex.en: A foul smell came from the old refrigerator.
ex.zh: 一股惡臭從那台舊冰箱裡散發出來。

ex.en: The water in the pond was green and foul.
ex.zh: 池塘裡的水又綠又臭。

ex.en: He has been in a foul mood since he lost his keys.
ex.zh: 自從弄丟鑰匙後，他就一直心情很差。

ex.en: The foul weather forced us to cancel the picnic.
ex.zh: 惡劣的天氣迫使我們取消野餐。

ex.en: The referee called a foul on the player for pushing.
ex.zh: 裁判判這名球員推人犯規。

ex.en: That was a clear foul, and the crowd booed loudly.
ex.zh: 那明顯是犯規，觀眾大聲喝倒彩。

ex.en: Signing the form is just a formality.
ex.zh: 簽這份表格只是個形式。

ex.en: There are a few formalities to complete before you can enter.
ex.zh: 入境前有幾項手續要辦理。

ex.en: The formality of the dinner made everyone nervous.
ex.zh: 晚宴的拘謹氣氛讓大家都很緊張。

ex.en: She greeted us with great formality.
ex.zh: 她非常正式地向我們問好。

ex.en: He wrote a letter to ask for her forgiveness.
ex.zh: 他寫了一封信請求她的原諒。

ex.en: Forgiveness can be difficult, but it brings peace.
ex.zh: 原諒雖然不容易，卻能帶來平靜。

ex.en: A narrow footpath leads through the fields to the river.
ex.zh: 一條窄窄的步道穿過田野通往河邊。

ex.en: Please keep the footpath clear for walkers.
ex.zh: 請保持步道暢通，讓行人通行。

ex.en: The soldiers guarded the old stone fort on the hill.
ex.zh: 士兵們守衛著山上的古老石堡。

ex.en: Tourists can walk around the fort and see the cannons.
ex.zh: 遊客可以在要塞四處走走，看那些大砲。

ex.en: The thick foliage kept the sun off the path.
ex.zh: 茂密的枝葉擋住了照在小路上的陽光。

ex.en: Tourists come in autumn to see the colorful foliage.
ex.zh: 遊客在秋天前來欣賞五彩繽紛的樹葉。

ex.en: The big painting is the focal point of the room.
ex.zh: 那幅大畫是整個房間的視覺焦點。

ex.en: The camera lens has a fixed focal length.
ex.zh: 這個相機鏡頭的焦距是固定的。

ex.en: Forensic experts examined the room for fingerprints.
ex.zh: 鑑識專家檢查房間裡有沒有指紋。

ex.en: Forensic evidence helped prove who did it.
ex.zh: 鑑識證據幫助證明了是誰做的。

ex.en: I changed the font to make the text easier to read.
ex.zh: 我換了字型，讓文字更好讀。

ex.en: This font looks too small on my phone.
ex.zh: 這個字型在我的手機上看起來太小了。

ex.en: The baby was baptized at the stone font in the church.
ex.zh: 嬰兒在教堂的石製洗禮盤前受洗。

ex.en: A font of holy water stood near the church entrance.
ex.zh: 教堂入口附近放著一個聖水盆。

ex.en: He is a founding member of the club.
ex.zh: 他是這個社團的創始成員。

ex.en: The founding fathers wrote the nation's first laws.
ex.zh: 開國元勳們寫下了這個國家最初的法律。

ex.en: She is founding a small company with her friend.
ex.zh: 她正和朋友創辦一家小公司。

ex.en: They are founding a school for deaf children.
ex.zh: 他們正在創辦一所聾童學校。

ex.en: The two countries were once bitter foes.
ex.zh: 這兩個國家曾經是死對頭。

ex.en: He treated his old foe with respect.
ex.zh: 他尊重地對待他的老對手。

ex.en: The old fortress stands on top of the hill.
ex.zh: 那座古老的要塞矗立在山頂上。

ex.en: Tourists walked through the stone fortress by the sea.
ex.zh: 遊客走過海邊的石造要塞。

ex.en: Her birthday is on the fourteenth of March.
ex.zh: 她的生日是三月十四日。

ex.en: He finished fourteenth in the race.
ex.zh: 他在比賽中跑了第十四名。

ex.en: He had a long scar on his left forearm.
ex.zh: 他的左前臂上有一道長長的疤痕。

ex.en: Tennis players need strong forearms.
ex.zh: 網球選手需要強壯的前臂。

ex.en: The footballer scored two goals in the final.
ex.zh: 那位足球員在決賽中進了兩球。

ex.en: He dreamed of becoming a professional footballer.
ex.zh: 他夢想成為職業足球員。

ex.en: We saw a small footprint in the wet sand.
ex.zh: 我們在濕沙地上看到一個小小的腳印。

ex.en: The detective found a muddy footprint by the door.
ex.zh: 偵探在門邊發現一個沾滿泥巴的腳印。

ex.en: The company is at the forefront of green technology.
ex.zh: 這家公司處於綠色科技的最前沿。

ex.en: She was always at the forefront of the movement.
ex.zh: 她始終站在這場運動的最前線。

ex.en: The child in the foreground is smiling at the camera.
ex.zh: 前景中的孩子正對著鏡頭微笑。

ex.en: The painter put a small boat in the foreground.
ex.zh: 畫家在前景畫了一艘小船。

ex.en: In the foreground of the photo, you can see a dog.
ex.zh: 照片的前景可以看到一隻狗。

ex.en: He lost his footing on the wet rocks and fell.
ex.zh: 他在濕滑的岩石上失去平衡而跌倒。

ex.en: Be careful, because the snow makes it hard to find a firm footing.
ex.zh: 小心，因為積雪讓人很難站穩腳步。

ex.en: The two companies are now on an equal footing.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司現在處於平等的地位。

ex.en: The new team is still finding its footing in the market.
ex.zh: 這個新團隊仍在市場上摸索站穩腳跟。

ex.en: The protesters were forcibly removed from the building.
ex.zh: 抗議者被強行帶離大樓。

ex.en: He forcibly pulled the door open.
ex.zh: 他用力把門拉開。

forceful.zh: 強而有力的、有說服力的

ex.en: She made a forceful speech about protecting the river.
ex.zh: 她發表了一場關於保護河川、強而有力的演說。

ex.en: He is a forceful leader who isn't afraid to decide.
ex.zh: 他是個強勢的領導者，不怕做決定。

ex.en: We waited in the theater foyer before the show.
ex.zh: 演出前我們在劇院的門廳等候。

ex.en: Please leave your shoes in the foyer.
ex.zh: 請把鞋子放在玄關。

ex.en: There will be no changes in the foreseeable future.
ex.zh: 在可預見的未來不會有任何改變。

ex.en: The accident was a foreseeable result of poor planning.
ex.zh: 這場意外是計畫不周可以預見的結果。

ex.en: I have forgotten my umbrella again.
ex.zh: 我又忘了帶雨傘。

ex.en: She had forgotten his name by the time they met again.
ex.zh: 等他們再次見面時，她已經忘了他的名字。

ex.en: The password was forgotten, so I had to reset it.
ex.zh: 密碼被忘記了，所以我得重設。

formative.zh: 形成期的、對成長有重大影響的

ex.en: The early years are formative for a child's personality.
ex.zh: 早年時期對孩子的個性形成影響重大。

ex.en: Living abroad was a formative experience for her.
ex.zh: 住在國外對她來說是一段影響深遠的成長經歷。

ex.en: We brought a folding table to the picnic.
ex.zh: 我們帶了一張摺疊桌去野餐。

ex.en: A folding chair is easy to store in a small apartment.
ex.zh: 摺疊椅很容易收納在小公寓裡。

ex.en: This was her first foray into the world of business.
ex.zh: 這是她首次涉足商業界。

ex.en: The band's foray into jazz surprised many fans.
ex.zh: 樂團初次嘗試爵士樂讓許多粉絲很驚訝。

ex.en: The soldiers made a quick foray into enemy territory at dawn.
ex.zh: 士兵在黎明時對敵方領地發動了一次快速的突襲。

ex.en: Wolves made forays from the forest to attack the sheep.
ex.zh: 狼群從森林裡出擊，攻擊羊群。

folded.zh: 摺疊；折起（fold 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: She folded the letter and put it in her bag.
ex.zh: 她把信摺好放進包包裡。

ex.en: The clothes were neatly folded on the bed.
ex.zh: 衣服整齊地摺好放在床上。

ex.en: He sat there with his arms folded.
ex.zh: 他雙臂交叉地坐在那裡。

ex.en: The teacher stood with her hands folded in front of her.
ex.zh: 老師雙手交疊站在身前。

ex.en: The small restaurant folded after only one year.
ex.zh: 那家小餐廳才開一年就倒閉了。

ex.en: The magazine folded when its owner ran out of money.
ex.zh: 老闆沒錢之後，那份雜誌就停刊了。

ex.en: She argued forcefully for a longer lunch break.
ex.zh: 她強烈主張延長午休時間。

ex.en: He pushed the door forcefully and it flew open.
ex.zh: 他用力推門，門猛地彈開了。

ex.en: She stayed focused and finished the report on time.
ex.zh: 她保持專注，準時完成了報告。

ex.en: The team is focused on improving customer service.
ex.zh: 團隊正專注於改善客戶服務。

ex.en: The forester checks the trees for disease every spring.
ex.zh: 林務員每年春天都會檢查樹木有沒有生病。

ex.en: A local forester led us along the mountain trail.
ex.zh: 一位當地的林務員帶我們走過山間步道。

ex.en: Our village sits in the foothills of the mountains.
ex.zh: 我們的村莊位在山脈的山麓小丘之間。

ex.en: We hiked through the foothill before sunrise.
ex.zh: 我們在日出前走過了山麓小丘。

ex.en: The foal stood up on its shaky legs just minutes after birth.
ex.zh: 小馬在出生幾分鐘後就用顫抖的腿站了起來。

ex.en: A mare and her foal were eating grass by the fence.
ex.zh: 一匹母馬和牠的小馬在圍欄旁吃草。

ex.en: She is a forgiving person who never holds a grudge.
ex.zh: 她是個寬容的人，從不記仇。

ex.en: The teacher was forgiving when I handed in my homework late.
ex.zh: 我晚交作業時，老師很寬容。

ex.en: Deer forage for food in the forest at night.
ex.zh: 鹿在夜裡到森林裡覓食。

ex.en: We foraged in the kitchen for something to eat.
ex.zh: 我們在廚房裡翻找東西吃。

ex.en: Farmers store forage for their cattle for the winter.
ex.zh: 農夫為牛群儲存過冬的飼料。

ex.en: The field provides good forage for the sheep.
ex.zh: 這片田野為羊群提供了不錯的飼料。

ex.en: The telegraph was a forerunner of the telephone.
ex.zh: 電報是電話的前身。

ex.en: She was a forerunner of women in science.
ex.zh: 她是女性投入科學領域的先驅。

ex.en: He will forfeit his deposit if he cancels the trip.
ex.zh: 如果他取消旅行，就會喪失訂金。

ex.en: The team had to forfeit the game for using an unfit player.
ex.zh: 這支球隊因為派了不符資格的球員而必須棄權認輸。

ex.en: Losing the game was the forfeit for breaking the rules.
ex.zh: 輸掉比賽是違規的代價。

ex.en: The prize became a forfeit when he missed the deadline.
ex.zh: 他錯過截止時間，獎品就被沒收了。

forbidding.zh: 令人望而生畏的；嚴峻的

ex.en: The old castle looked dark and forbidding.
ex.zh: 那座古堡看起來陰暗而令人生畏。

ex.en: He had a forbidding face that scared the children.
ex.zh: 他有一張嚴厲的臉，把孩子們嚇到了。

ex.en: The sign forbidding entry was clear.
ex.zh: 那塊禁止進入的告示很清楚。

ex.en: She is forbidding her son from playing games on school nights.
ex.zh: 她禁止兒子在上課日的晚上玩遊戲。

ex.en: The shop sells basic foodstuffs such as rice and flour.
ex.zh: 這家店販售米和麵粉等基本食品。

ex.en: Prices of many foodstuffs have gone up this year.
ex.zh: 今年許多食品的價格上漲了。

ex.en: Smoking is strictly forbidden in the building.
ex.zh: 這棟建築內嚴禁吸菸。

ex.en: The forbidden fruit always seems more attractive.
ex.zh: 禁果似乎總是更有吸引力。

ex.en: Students are forbidden to use phones during the exam.
ex.zh: 考試期間禁止學生使用手機。

ex.en: My parents have forbidden me from staying out late.
ex.zh: 父母已禁止我在外面待到很晚。

ex.en: He was arrested for forgery after signing her name on the check.
ex.zh: 他在支票上簽了她的名字，因偽造罪被捕。

ex.en: Experts proved the painting was a forgery.
ex.zh: 專家證明這幅畫是贗品。

ex.en: The museum has a special team to detect forgeries.
ex.zh: 博物館有專門的小組來辨識偽造品。

ex.en: Cooking is not my forte, so I order takeout a lot.
ex.zh: 煮飯不是我的強項，所以我常叫外賣。

ex.en: Math was always his forte at school.
ex.zh: 數學一直是他在學校的強項。

ex.en: Public speaking is her forte.
ex.zh: 公開演講是她的拿手項目。

ex.en: The manager ordered the workers to leave the building forthwith.
ex.zh: 經理命令員工立即離開大樓。

ex.en: You must pay the fine forthwith.
ex.zh: 你必須立刻繳交罰款。

ex.en: I decided to forgo dessert and have some tea instead.
ex.zh: 我決定不吃甜點，改喝點茶。

ex.en: She had to forgo a vacation to save money for school.
ex.zh: 她為了存學費，只好放棄度假。

ex.en: Weather forecasting has become more accurate over the years.
ex.zh: 天氣預報這些年來越來越準確。

ex.en: Sales forecasting helps the company plan how much to produce.
ex.zh: 銷售預測能幫公司規劃要生產多少。

ex.en: The city fortified its walls before the enemy arrived.
ex.zh: 敵人到來之前，這座城市加強了城牆。

ex.en: Many cereals are fortified with extra vitamins.
ex.zh: 許多穀片都添加了額外的維生素。

ex.en: A good night's sleep will fortify you for tomorrow's exam.
ex.zh: 睡個好覺能讓你有力氣面對明天的考試。

ex.en: She fortified herself with a cup of tea before the meeting.
ex.zh: 她開會前喝了杯茶給自己打氣。

ex.en: She fondly remembered the summers at her grandmother's house.
ex.zh: 她懷念地回想起在外婆家度過的夏天。

ex.en: He smiled fondly at his sleeping daughter.
ex.zh: 他深情地看著熟睡的女兒微笑。

ex.en: The farmer stored fodder for the cows in the barn.
ex.zh: 農夫把乳牛的飼料存放在穀倉裡。

ex.en: There was not enough fodder for the animals last winter.
ex.zh: 去年冬天動物的飼料不夠。

ex.en: Her embarrassing mistake became fodder for jokes at work.
ex.zh: 她那次尷尬的失誤成了同事間開玩笑的材料。

ex.en: The scandal was fodder for the tabloids for weeks.
ex.zh: 這件醜聞連續幾週都是小報的題材。

ex.en: Foucault was a French philosopher who wrote about power and society.
ex.zh: 傅科是一位探討權力與社會的法國哲學家。

ex.en: Our professor asked us to read a chapter by Foucault.
ex.zh: 教授要我們讀傅科的一個章節。

ex.en: The village sits in a deep, forested valley.
ex.zh: 這個村莊位於一座森林茂密的深谷裡。

ex.en: About half of the island is forested.
ex.zh: 這座島大約一半被森林覆蓋。

ex.en: The wedding cake was covered with smooth white fondant.
ex.zh: 那個婚禮蛋糕覆蓋著光滑的白色翻糖。

ex.en: She rolled out the fondant and cut it into little stars.
ex.zh: 她把翻糖擀開，切成小星星的形狀。

ex.en: He pointed at the map with his forefinger.
ex.zh: 他用食指指著地圖。

ex.en: She held the tiny seed between her thumb and forefinger.
ex.zh: 她用拇指和食指捏著那顆小種子。

ex.en: She had the foresight to save money for a rainy day.
ex.zh: 她有先見之明，早早存錢以備不時之需。

ex.en: A little foresight could have prevented this problem.
ex.zh: 只要稍有遠見，這個問題本來是可以避免的。

ex.en: She gave a forthright answer to every question.
ex.zh: 她對每個問題都直率地回答。

ex.en: I appreciate his forthright opinion, even if it hurts.
ex.zh: 即使有點刺耳，我還是欣賞他坦白的意見。

ex.en: The dog looked forlorn sitting alone by the door.
ex.zh: 那隻狗孤零零坐在門邊，看起來好淒涼。

ex.en: She gave a forlorn sigh as the train left.
ex.zh: 火車開走時，她發出一聲落寞的嘆息。

ex.en: His forebears came from Ireland.
ex.zh: 他的祖先來自愛爾蘭。

ex.en: We visited the village where my forebears lived.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了我祖先住過的村子。

ex.en: He never forsook his friends in hard times.
ex.zh: 他在艱難時期從未拋棄朋友。

ex.en: She forsook her career to care for her mother.
ex.zh: 她為了照顧母親放棄了事業。

ex.en: The farm raises chickens and other fowl.
ex.zh: 這座農場養雞和其他家禽。

ex.en: Wild fowl gather by the lake every winter.
ex.zh: 每年冬天野禽都會聚集在湖邊。

fortified.zh: 設防的；築有防禦工事的

ex.en: The town was surrounded by a fortified wall.
ex.zh: 小鎮被一道築有防禦工事的城牆包圍。

ex.en: They hid inside a fortified castle on the hill.
ex.zh: 他們躲進山丘上一座設有防禦工事的城堡。

ex.en: Many breakfast cereals are fortified with vitamins.
ex.zh: 許多早餐穀片都添加了維生素。

ex.en: This fortified milk has extra calcium.
ex.zh: 這種強化牛奶含有額外的鈣。

ex.en: Several taxis were waiting in the forecourt of the station.
ex.zh: 幾輛計程車在車站前廣場等客。

ex.en: The hotel has a large forecourt with a fountain in the middle.
ex.zh: 那家飯店有個很大的前庭，中央有座噴泉。

ex.en: The school is fostering a love of reading among its students.
ex.zh: 學校正在培養學生對閱讀的熱愛。

ex.en: They are fostering two kittens until they find permanent homes.
ex.zh: 在小貓找到永久的家之前，他們暫時照顧著牠們。

ex.en: I foolishly left my umbrella at home.
ex.zh: 我愚蠢地把雨傘忘在家裡。

ex.en: He foolishly trusted a stranger with his money.
ex.zh: 他愚蠢地把錢託付給一個陌生人。

ex.en: The doctor checked the heartbeat of the foetus.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查了胎兒的心跳。

ex.en: A foetus grows quickly in the last months of pregnancy.
ex.zh: 胎兒在懷孕的最後幾個月成長得很快。

ex.en: The police found a forged passport in his bag.
ex.zh: 警方在他的包包裡發現一本偽造的護照。

ex.en: The painting turned out to be a forged copy.
ex.zh: 那幅畫結果是偽造的仿作。

ex.en: The blacksmith forged a sword from a single piece of iron.
ex.zh: 鐵匠用一整塊鐵鍛造出一把劍。

ex.en: The two countries forged a strong friendship over the years.
ex.zh: 這兩個國家多年來建立起堅固的友誼。

ex.en: The metal was melted in a foundry and poured into molds.
ex.zh: 金屬在鑄造廠裡熔化後倒入模具。

ex.en: His grandfather worked at an iron foundry for thirty years.
ex.zh: 他的祖父在一家鐵鑄造廠工作了三十年。

ex.en: It was pure foolishness to drive in that storm.
ex.zh: 在那場暴風雨中開車實在太愚蠢了。

ex.en: He regrets the foolishness of his younger days.
ex.zh: 他對年輕時的愚蠢行為感到後悔。

ex.en: The dark clouds foreshadowed a storm.
ex.zh: 烏雲預示著暴風雨即將來臨。

ex.en: The first chapter foreshadows the tragic ending of the novel.
ex.zh: 第一章預示了這本小說悲劇性的結局。

ex.en: The author's friend wrote the foreword to the book.
ex.zh: 作者的朋友為這本書寫了序。

ex.en: I always skip the foreword and start with chapter one.
ex.zh: 我總是跳過前言，直接從第一章開始讀。

ex.en: She felt a strange foreboding as the sky turned dark.
ex.zh: 天色變暗時，她心裡有一種奇怪的不祥預感。

ex.en: A sense of foreboding filled the room before the news arrived.
ex.zh: 消息傳來之前，房間裡瀰漫著不祥的預感。

ex.en: The old fortification on the hill protected the town for centuries.
ex.zh: 山丘上的古老防禦工事保護這座城鎮好幾百年。

ex.en: Workers began the fortification of the border village before winter.
ex.zh: 工人在冬天來臨前開始為邊境村莊修築防禦工事。

ex.en: Based on the foregoing evidence, we can reach a conclusion.
ex.zh: 根據前述的證據，我們可以得出結論。

ex.en: The foregoing paragraphs explain how the system works.
ex.zh: 前面幾段已說明這個系統如何運作。

ex.en: We made up a foursome for a game of golf on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我們湊成四人一組，星期六去打高爾夫。

ex.en: The foursome ordered a large pizza to share.
ex.zh: 這四個人點了一個大披薩一起分著吃。

foreclose.zh: 取消抵押品贖回權；法拍

ex.en: The bank may foreclose on the house if you stop paying.
ex.zh: 如果你停止繳款，銀行可能會法拍這棟房子。

ex.en: Many families lost their homes when lenders foreclosed.
ex.zh: 貸款機構取消贖回權時，許多家庭失去了房子。

ex.en: The two companies will formalize their agreement next week.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司下星期將正式簽訂協議。

ex.en: We need to formalize the rules so everyone follows them.
ex.zh: 我們需要把規則正式化，讓每個人都遵守。

ex.en: The government acted quickly to forestall a crisis.
ex.zh: 政府迅速行動，以防危機發生。

ex.en: He raised his hand to forestall any further questions.
ex.zh: 他舉起手阻止大家再發問。

ex.en: Reading is a foundational skill for all school subjects.
ex.zh: 閱讀是所有學科的基礎能力。

ex.en: The course covers foundational ideas in physics before moving on to harder topics.
ex.zh: 這門課先講解物理的基本概念，再進入較難的主題。

ex.en: The library keeps an old folio of the poet's work.
ex.zh: 圖書館收藏著這位詩人作品的一本舊對開本。

ex.en: Each folio of the manuscript was carefully numbered.
ex.zh: 手稿的每一張對開頁都仔細編了號。

ex.en: He joined the school forensics team to practice public speaking.
ex.zh: 他加入學校的辯論隊來練習公開演說。

ex.en: Her forensics coach taught her how to build a strong argument.
ex.zh: 她的辯論教練教她如何建立有力的論點。

ex.en: Forensics experts examined the room for fingerprints.
ex.zh: 鑑識專家檢查了房間裡有沒有指紋。

ex.en: Digital forensics can recover deleted files from a phone.
ex.zh: 數位鑑識可以從手機中救回被刪除的檔案。

ex.en: She faced her illness with great fortitude.
ex.zh: 她以極大的堅毅面對自己的病痛。

ex.en: It took fortitude to keep going after so many failures.
ex.zh: 在這麼多次失敗之後還能繼續前進，需要堅忍的毅力。

ex.en: The team showed fortitude in the face of difficulty.
ex.zh: 團隊在面對困難時展現了堅韌的精神。

ex.en: I decided to forego dessert tonight.
ex.zh: 我決定今晚不吃甜點了。

ex.en: She chose to forego a vacation to save money.
ex.zh: 她選擇放棄度假來存錢。

foolproof.zh: 萬無一失的、簡單易懂的

ex.en: This recipe is foolproof, even for beginners.
ex.zh: 這份食譜連初學者也不會失敗。

ex.en: No security system is completely foolproof.
ex.zh: 沒有任何保全系統是完全萬無一失的。

ex.en: Our forefathers worked hard to build this village.
ex.zh: 我們的祖先辛勤工作建立了這個村莊。

ex.en: He honored his forefathers by keeping the old traditions.
ex.zh: 他保留傳統來緬懷自己的祖先。

ex.en: Our meeting was entirely fortuitous.
ex.zh: 我們的相遇完全是個巧合。

ex.en: It was a fortuitous accident that led to the discovery.
ex.zh: 一次偶然的意外促成了這項發現。

ex.en: We have a fortnightly meeting on Thursday mornings.
ex.zh: 我們每兩週的星期四早上開一次會。

ex.en: The magazine is published as a fortnightly review.
ex.zh: 這份雜誌每兩週出刊一次。

ex.en: The cleaners come fortnightly to tidy the office.
ex.zh: 清潔人員每兩週來整理一次辦公室。

ex.en: The club meets fortnightly in the library.
ex.zh: 這個社團每兩週在圖書館聚會一次。

ex.en: It would be foolhardy to swim in such a strong current.
ex.zh: 在這麼強的水流裡游泳是有勇無謀的。

ex.en: The foolhardy climber ignored the weather warning.
ex.zh: 那位魯莽的登山者無視天氣警告。

ex.en: The foaming waves crashed against the rocks.
ex.zh: 泛著泡沫的浪花拍打著岩石。

ex.en: A foaming cup of beer sat on the table.
ex.zh: 桌上放著一杯冒著泡沫的啤酒。

ex.en: The soap is foaming in the sink.
ex.zh: 肥皂在水槽裡起了泡沫。

ex.en: The river was foaming after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後河水翻騰起泡。

ex.en: He attached a key fob to his car keys.
ex.zh: 他在車鑰匙上掛了個鑰匙圈飾品。

ex.en: The old man wore a silver fob on his vest.
ex.zh: 老先生的背心上掛著一條銀色的錶鏈。

ex.en: The two companies will formalise the deal next week.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司下週會把協議正式化。

ex.en: We should formalise these rules in writing.
ex.zh: 我們應該把這些規定以書面確定下來。

ex.en: The police made a forcible entry into the building.
ex.zh: 警方強行進入那棟建築物。

ex.en: There was no sign of forcible removal of the lock.
ex.zh: 沒有鎖被強行破壞的跡象。

ex.en: The doctor checked the foetal heartbeat during the exam.
ex.zh: 醫師在檢查時聽了胎兒的心跳。

ex.en: She slept curled up in a foetal position.
ex.zh: 她蜷縮成胎兒的姿勢睡覺。

ex.en: My grandmother has become forgetful in her old age.
ex.zh: 我奶奶年紀大了變得健忘。

ex.en: I am so forgetful that I leave my keys at home almost every week.
ex.zh: 我很健忘，幾乎每週都會把鑰匙忘在家裡。

ex.en: No one could foretell what would happen next.
ex.zh: 沒有人能預知接下來會發生什麼事。

ex.en: The old woman claimed she could foretell the weather.
ex.zh: 老婦人聲稱她能預測天氣。

ex.en: Fourthly, we need to think about the cost.
ex.zh: 第四，我們得考慮成本。

ex.en: First we plan, second we build, third we test, and fourthly we launch.
ex.zh: 首先規劃，其次建造，第三測試，第四上線。

formaldehyde.zh: 甲醛（一種有刺鼻氣味的化學物質）

ex.en: Formaldehyde has a sharp smell that irritates the eyes and nose.
ex.zh: 甲醛有刺鼻的氣味，會刺激眼睛和鼻子。

ex.en: New furniture can release small amounts of formaldehyde into the air.
ex.zh: 新家具可能會向空氣中釋放少量甲醛。

foregone.zh: 預先決定的；早已註定的

ex.en: The result of the match was a foregone conclusion.
ex.zh: 這場比賽的結果早已是定局。

ex.en: With such a big lead, victory seemed foregone.
ex.zh: 領先這麼多，勝利似乎已經註定。

ex.en: The warm spring day gave us a foretaste of summer.
ex.zh: 這個溫暖的春日讓我們先嘗到夏天的滋味。

ex.en: The first test was a foretaste of the challenges ahead.
ex.zh: 第一次測試預示了接下來的挑戰。

ex.en: We crossed the river by a narrow footbridge.
ex.zh: 我們走一座狹窄的人行橋過河。

ex.en: The city built a new footbridge over the busy highway.
ex.zh: 市府在繁忙的公路上方蓋了一座新的人行天橋。

ex.en: Everyone has a foible, and mine is always being late.
ex.zh: 每個人都有小缺點，我的就是老是遲到。

ex.en: She smiled at her husband's little foibles.
ex.zh: 她對丈夫的小怪癖會心一笑。

ex.en: The movie's plot was formulaic and easy to predict.
ex.zh: 這部電影的劇情很公式化，一猜就中。

ex.en: His thank-you letter sounded formulaic, not sincere.
ex.zh: 他的感謝信讀起來很老套，不夠真誠。

folksy.zh: 平易近人的；樸實親切的

ex.en: The mayor has a folksy way of talking to voters.
ex.zh: 市長和選民說話的方式平易近人又親切。

ex.en: The cafe has a folksy charm with its wooden tables.
ex.zh: 那間咖啡館有著木桌帶來的質樸魅力。

ex.en: The teacher forewarned us that the test would be hard.
ex.zh: 老師預先警告我們考試會很難。

ex.en: I should forewarn you that the road is closed.
ex.zh: 我得先提醒你，那條路封閉了。

ex.en: His forgetfulness gets worse when he is tired.
ex.zh: 他一累就更健忘。

ex.en: She blamed her forgetfulness on a busy week.
ex.zh: 她把自己的健忘歸咎於忙碌的一週。

ex.en: Each hair grows from a tiny follicle in the skin.
ex.zh: 每根頭髮都從皮膚裡的一個小毛囊長出來。

ex.en: An infected follicle can look like a small red bump.
ex.zh: 發炎的毛囊看起來可能像個紅色小腫塊。

ex.en: Many fruits, for example mangoes and bananas, grow well in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 許多水果，例如芒果和香蕉，在台灣長得很好。

ex.en: You can do something relaxing, for example reading or taking a walk.
ex.zh: 你可以做些放鬆的事，例如看書或散步。

ex.en: Some jobs require teamwork. For example, nurses work closely with doctors.
ex.zh: 有些工作需要團隊合作，例如護理師就要和醫生密切配合。

for example.en: used when you give one thing to show what you mean

ex.en: He moved abroad for good after he got married.
ex.zh: 他結婚後就永遠搬到國外了。

ex.en: I quit sugar for good last year.
ex.zh: 我去年徹底戒掉了糖。

ex.en: They hope to fix the leak for good this time.
ex.zh: 這次他們希望能一勞永逸地修好漏水。

ex.en: I don't know for sure when the train leaves.
ex.zh: 我不確定火車什麼時候開。

ex.en: She will come to the party for sure.
ex.zh: 她一定會來參加派對。

ex.en: Nobody can say for sure what will happen next.
ex.zh: 沒有人能確定接下來會發生什麼事。
